items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: This is some information, I guess, from your uncle Monette had told Lomax once

ctx.x: Dr. Crozant told me one time that the only Peche is he was a- was a bishop, and the bishop had a brother, so my grandmother might have- his name was Peche, Bishop Peche, and he had a brother. And my grandmother lived in Exposition Boulevard all the time. She traveled all over the world with the Solari's. Every time she had a child, Miss Solari would have one. She was a wet nurse. You see, a long time ago, they used wet names. Yeah, that's right. I heard about it. My grandmother, I know that she had one son, and…

Um, let's see. This is some information, I guess, from your uncle Monette had told Lomax once, about the- the Jell-Roll's father, Lamont, played slide trombone. Did you ever know the- No. The Jell-Roll playing any other instruments? No. He said he played a little bit on guitar and- I wouldn't know that, no. He never mentioned anything to you about it. Or in Chicago, you wouldn't have seen him play any other instruments? No. Drums or- No.

Or trombones or guitar? He didn't do anything. But I mean, he would practice with the band, and conduct the band, and play the piano. I've never seen him do anything else. Did he rehearse any bands at his home when you were there?
